reasoning_chain: Multiple slow edges radiate from frontend to many different callees including adservice, cartservice, checkoutservice, currencyservice, productcatalogservice, recommendationservice, and shippingservice.
All these callees have low p95 latencies themselves, indicating they are not slow processing requests but are delayed before getting CPU.
Frontend's own p95 latency is very high at 1673.53ms, while its CPU usage is 74% of its very low CPU limit (0.007 of 0.010 cores), indicating CPU throttling.
No other service shows multiple independent callers slow toward it, so frontend is the root cause.
Frontend pod was recently recreated due to a CPU limit reduction from 200m to 10m, causing resource exhaustion and latency.
No errors are reported on frontend or its callees, consistent with latency caused by resource exhaustion rather than crashes or failures.
